text: An apple is a sweet, edible fruit produced by an apple tree. The fruit is typically red, green, or yellow and is rich in fibre and vitamin C.
A banana is a long curved fruit that grows in clusters. Bananas are rich in potassium and are typically yellow when ripe.
Elephants are large grey mammals with long trunks and tusks. They are the largest living land animals on Earth.
Zebras are African equines distinguished by their distinctive black-and-white striped coats. They are highly social animals.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation combines a retrieval step with a generation step. A retriever finds relevant context and a language model uses that context to answer.
Vector databases store high-dimensional embeddings and support nearest-neighbour search. Common implementations include FAISS, Qdrant, pgvector, and Pinecone.
Claude is a family of large language models developed by Anthropic. Claude models support tool use, vision, and long-context reasoning.
The Model Context Protocol is an open standard for connecting AI assistants to external systems. MCP servers expose tools, resources, and prompts to AI clients.
